# Gagan Bhatia

Gagan Bhatia is a first-year PhD candidate at the Chair of Computer Science
and Artificial Intelligence (CSAI), University of Technology Nuremberg,
advised by Steffen Eger. His research covers evaluation metrics for
generative text and multimodal models, temporal reasoning and tokenisation
in large language models, and multilingual and Arabic NLP.
